children.text: samyaganugatārthe yāvatā sarvadharmān mokṣa jagata arthe jāyate bodhicittam // 20 //
children.translated_text: for the sake of rightly pursuing all <s>dharmas</s> in their true meaning, for the liberation of the world — <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (20)

children.text: pramuditasamutīnāṃ dānadharmāratānāṃ sakalajagahitārthe nityamevodyatānām /
children.translated_text: Of those born with joy on the <s>Pramuditā</s> (Joyful) [stage], who delight in the <s>dharma</s> of giving, who are always striving for the benefit of all the world,

children.text: jinaguṇaniratānāṃ sattvarakṣāvratānāṃ tribhuvanahitakārye jāyate bodhicittam // 21 //
children.translated_text: who take pleasure in the qualities of the <s>Jinas</s>, whose vow is the protection of beings — for the welfare of the three worlds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (21)

children.text: akuśalaviratānāṃ śuddhaśīlāvratānāṃ vrataniyamaratānāṃ śāntasaumyendriyāṇām /
children.translated_text: Of those who abstain from unwholesome deeds, who maintain pure <s>śīla</s> (morality) and vows, who delight in the observance of precepts, whose faculties are peaceful and gentle,

children.text: jinaśaraṇagatānāṃ bodhicaryāśayānāṃ tribhuvanahitasādhyaṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 22//
children.translated_text: who have taken refuge in the <s>Jinas</s>, whose aspiration is for the conduct of awakening — for the accomplishment of the welfare of the three worlds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (22)

children.text: anugatakuśalānāṃ kṣāntisauratyabhājāṃ viditaguṇarasānāṃ tyaktamānotsavānām /
children.translated_text: Of those who pursue the wholesome, who share in <s>kṣānti</s> (patience) and gentleness, who know the taste of virtues, who have abandoned the festival of pride,

children.text: nihitaśubhamatīnāṃ dāntusaumyāśayānāṃ sakalahitavidhāne jāyate bodhicittam // 23 //
children.translated_text: whose auspicious minds are firmly established, whose dispositions are tamed and gentle — for the arrangement of universal welfare, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (23)

body.text: pracalitaśubhakāryā dhīravīryotsahā ye nikhilajanahitārthe prodyayāmāna siṃhāḥ /
body.translated_text: Those who have set in motion auspicious works, who are bold with steadfast <s>vīrya</s> (energy), like lions arising for the benefit of all people,

body.text: avirataguṇasādhyā nirjitakleśasaṃghā jhaṭiti manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 24 //
body.translated_text: who ceaselessly accomplish virtues, who have conquered the host of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions) — instantly in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (24)

children.text: susamavahitacittā dhvastamohāndhakārā vigalitamadamānā tyaktasaṃkliṣṭamārgāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those whose minds are well-composed, who have destroyed the darkness of delusion, whose intoxication and pride have dissolved, who have abandoned the defiled path,

children.text: śamasukhaniratā ye tyaktasaṃsārasaṅgā jhaṭiti manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 25//
children.translated_text: who delight in the happiness of tranquility, who have renounced attachment to <s>saṃsāra</s> — instantly in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (25)

children.text: vimalakhasamacittā jñānavijñānavijñā nihatanamucimārā vāntakleśābhimānāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those whose minds are pure like space, who are skilled in <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge) and <s>vijñāna</s> (discernment), who have slain <s>Namuchi</s> (Māra), who have vomited out the pride of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions),

children.text: jinapadaśaraṇasthā labdhatattvārthakā ye sapadi manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 26 //
children.translated_text: who stand in the refuge of the <s>Jinas</s>' feet, who have obtained the meaning of truth — at once in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (26)

children.text: tribhuvanaśivasādhyopāyavijñānadhīrāḥ kalibalaparihāropāyavidyarddhimantaḥ /
children.translated_text: Those steadfast in the knowledge of skillful means for accomplishing the welfare of the three worlds, possessing the power and science of means for averting the forces of strife,

children.text: sugataguṇasamīhā ye ca puṇyānurāgāḥ sapadi manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 27 //
children.translated_text: who aspire to the qualities of the <s>Sugatas</s>, who are devoted to merit — at once in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (27)

children.text: tribhuvanahitakāmā bodhisaṃbhārapūrye praṇihitamanasā ye duṣkare 'pi caranti /
children.translated_text: Those who desire the welfare of the three worlds, who with resolute minds practice even what is difficult to do for the fulfillment of the accumulations of <s>bodhi</s> (awakening),

children.text: avirataśubhakarmaprodyatā bodhisattvāḥ sapadi manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 28 //
children.translated_text: the <s>bodhisattvas</s> ceaselessly striving in auspicious deeds — at once in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (28)

children.text: daśabalaguṇakāmā bodhicaryānuraktā vijitakalibalaughāstyaktamānānuṣaṅgāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who desire the qualities of the Ten-Powered One, who are devoted to the conduct of awakening, who have conquered the flood of the forces of strife, who have abandoned the attachment to pride,

children.text: anugataśubhamārgā labdhadharmārthakāmā jhaṭiti manasi teṣāṃ jāyate bodhicittam // 29 //
children.translated_text: who follow the auspicious path, who have obtained the goals of <s>Dharma</s> and meaning — instantly in their minds, <s>bodhicitta</s> arises. (29)

children.text: iti gaṇitaguṇāṃśā bodhicaryāścarantu jinapadapraṇidhānāḥ satsamṛddhiṃ labhantu /
children.translated_text: Thus, having enumerated these portions of virtue, may they practice the conduct of awakening; may those who aspire to the feet of the <s>Jinas</s> obtain true prosperity;

children.text: triguṇapariviśuddhā bodhicittaṃ labhantu triśaraṇapariśuddhā bodhisattvā bhavantu // 30 //
children.translated_text: may they, purified in the three qualities, obtain <s>bodhicitta</s>; purified through the three refuges, may they become <s>bodhisattvas</s>! (30)

children.text: daśa pāramitāḥ pūrya daśabhūmīśvaro bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having fulfilled the ten <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections), one becomes lord of the ten <s>bhūmis</s> (stages);

children.text: bhūyo 'pi kathyate hyetacchruṇutaivaṃ samāsataḥ // 31 //
children.translated_text: this shall be spoken of further — listen thus in summary. (31)

children.text: bodhicittaṃ yadāsādya saṃpradānaṃ karoti yaḥ /
children.translated_text: When one, having attained <s>bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening), practices giving,

children.text: tadā pramuditāṃ prāpto jambūdvīpeśvaro bhavet // 32 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Pramuditā</s> (the Joyful stage), one becomes lord of <s>Jambudvīpa</s>. (32)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān yathecchāpratipādanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through fulfilling their wishes,

children.text: svayaṃ dāne pratiṣṭhitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet // 33 //
children.translated_text: having oneself become established in <s>dāna</s> (generosity), one should also direct others [to it]. (33)

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya saṃpūrṇā dānapāragaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having established all in <s>bodhi</s> (awakening), one who has gone to the far shore of <s>dāna</s> (generosity),

children.text: etaddharmānubhāvena saṃvaraṃ samupācaret // 34 //
children.translated_text: by the power of this <s>dharma</s>, should undertake the <s>saṃvara</s> (moral restraint). (34)

children.text: samyakśīlaṃ samādhāya saṃvarakuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having rightly established <s>śīla</s> (morality), one becomes skilled in <s>saṃvara</s> (restraint);

children.text: tataḥ sa vimalāṃ prāptaścāturdvīpeśvaro bhavet // 35 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Vimalā</s> (the Stainless stage), one becomes lord of the four continents. (35)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān akuśalanivāraṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through the prevention of unwholesome deeds,

children.text: svayaṃ śīle pratiṣṭhitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet // 36 //
children.translated_text: having oneself become established in <s>śīla</s> (morality), one should also direct others [to it]. (36)

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya saṃpūrṇaśīlapāragaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one who has gone to the far shore of <s>śīla</s> (morality),

children.text: etaddharmavipākena kṣāntivratamupāśrayet // 37 //
children.translated_text: by the ripening of this <s>dharma</s>, should take up the vow of <s>kṣānti</s> (patience). (37)

children.text: samyakkṣāntivrataṃ dhṛtvā kṣāntibhṛtkuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having upheld the vow of right <s>kṣānti</s> (patience), one becomes a bearer of patience, skilled [in virtue];

children.text: tataḥ prabhākarīprāptastrayastriṃśādhipo bhavet // 38 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Prabhākarī</s> (the Luminous stage), one becomes lord of the Thirty-Three [gods]. (38)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān kleśamārganivāraṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through averting the path of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions),

children.text: svayaṃ kṣāntivrate sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet // 39 //
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in the vow of <s>kṣānti</s> (patience), one should also direct others [to it]. (39)

children.text: sattvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya kṣāntipāraṃgato bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having established beings in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>kṣānti</s> (patience);

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākaiḥ sa vīryavratamupāśrayet // 40 //
children.translated_text: by the fruits of this merit, one should take up the vow of <s>vīrya</s> (energy). (40)

children.text: samyagvīryaṃ samādhāya vīryabhṛt kuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having rightly established <s>vīrya</s> (energy), one becomes a bearer of energy, skilled [in virtue];

children.text: tataścārciṣmatīprāptaḥ suyāmādhipatirbhavet // 41 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Arciṣmatī</s> (the Radiant stage), one becomes lord of the <s>Suyāma</s> heaven. (41)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān kudṛṣṭisaṃnivāraṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through averting wrong views,

children.text: samyagdṛṣṭau pratiṣṭhāpya bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ // 42 //
children.translated_text: establishing them in right view, awakening them with effort, (42)

children.text: svayaṃ vīryavrate sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in the vow of <s>vīrya</s> (energy), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya vīryapāraṃgato bhavet // 43 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>vīrya</s> (energy). (43)

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākaiśca dhyānavrataṃ samāśrayet /
children.translated_text: By the fruits of this merit, one should take up the vow of <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation);

children.text: sarvakleśān vinirjitya samādhisuṣṭhito bhavet // 44 //
children.translated_text: having conquered all <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions), one becomes well-established in <s>samādhi</s> (concentration). (44)

children.text: samyag dhyānaṃ samādhāya samādhikuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having rightly established <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation), one becomes skilled in <s>samādhi</s> (concentration);

children.text: tataḥ sudurjayāprāptaḥ saṃtuṣitādhipo bhavet // 45 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Sudurjayā</s> (the Hard-to-Conquer stage), one becomes lord of <s>Saṃtuṣita</s> (Tuṣita heaven). (45)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān tīrthyamārganivāraṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through averting the path of heretics,

children.text: satyadharmaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ // 46 //
children.translated_text: establishing the true <s>Dharma</s>, awakening them with effort, (46)

children.text: svayaṃ dhyānavrate sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in the vow of <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya dhyānapāraṃgato bhavet // 47 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation). (47)

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākaiśca prajñāvratamupāśrayet /
children.translated_text: By the fruits of this merit, one should take up the vow of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom);

children.text: sarvamārān vinirjitya prajñābhijñasamṛddhimān // 48 //
children.translated_text: having conquered all <s>Māras</s>, one becomes endowed with the attainment of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom) and <s>abhijñā</s> (superknowledge). (48)

children.text: samyakprajñāṃ samādhāya svabhijñākuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having rightly established <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom), one becomes skilled in <s>abhijñā</s> (superknowledge);

children.text: tataścābhimukhīprāptaḥ sunirmitādhipo bhavet // 49 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Abhimukhī</s> (the Facing stage), one becomes lord of the <s>Sunirmita</s> heaven. (49)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān abhimānanivāraṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through the removal of <s>abhimāna</s> (conceit),

children.text: śūnyatāsu pratiṣṭhāpya bodhayitvā prayatnataḥ // 50 //
children.translated_text: establishing them in <s>śūnyatā</s> (emptiness), awakening them with effort, (50)

children.text: svayaṃ prajñāvrate sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in the vow of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya prajñāpāraṃgato bhavet // 51 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom). (51)

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākaiśca sa supāyavrataṃ caret /
children.translated_text: By the fruits of this merit, one should practice the vow of <s>upāya</s> (skillful means);

children.text: sarvaduṣṭān vinirjitya saddharmakuśalī bhavet // 52 //
children.translated_text: having conquered all the wicked, one becomes skilled in the true <s>Dharma</s>. (52)

children.text: sa supāyavidhānena sattvān bodhau niyojayet /
children.translated_text: Through the method of <s>upāya</s> (skillful means), one directs beings toward <s>bodhi</s> (awakening);

children.text: tato dūraṃgamāprāpto vaśavartīśvaro bhavet // 53 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Dūraṃgamā</s> (the Far-Going stage), one becomes lord of the <s>Vaśavartin</s> [heaven]. (53)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvānabhisamayabodhanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through instructions in <s>abhisamaya</s> (realization),

children.text: bodhisattvaniyāmeṣu pratiṣṭhāpya prabodhayan // 54 //
children.translated_text: establishing them in the certainties of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, awakening them, (54)

children.text: tatropāye svayaṃ sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in <s>upāya</s> (skillful means), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya hyupāyapārago bhavet // 55 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>upāya</s> (skillful means). (55)

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvaiśca supraṇidhimupāśrayet /
children.translated_text: By the power of this merit, one should take up excellent <s>praṇidhāna</s> (vows);

children.text: mithyādṛṣṭiṃ vinirjitya samyagdṛṣṭikṛtī budhaḥ // 56 //
children.translated_text: having conquered wrong views, one becomes a doer of right views, a wise one. (56)

children.text: supraṇihitacittena samyagbodhau pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: With a mind of excellent <s>praṇidhāna</s> (vows), established in perfect <s>bodhi</s> (awakening),

children.text: tataścāpyacalāprāpto brahmā sāhasrikādhipaḥ // 57 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Acalā</s> (the Immovable stage), one becomes <s>Brahmā</s>, lord of the thousandfold [world]. (57)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān triyānasaṃpraveśanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through introduction to the three vehicles,

children.text: lokadhātuparijñāne pratiṣṭhāpya prabodhayan // 58 //
children.translated_text: establishing them in the thorough knowledge of world-systems, awakening them, (58)

children.text: supraṇidhau svayaṃ sthitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself remained in excellent <s>praṇidhāna</s> (vows), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya praṇidhipārago bhavet // 59 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>praṇidhāna</s> (vows). (59)

children.text: etatpuṇyānusāraiśca balavratamupāśrayet /
children.translated_text: Following the course of this merit, one should take up the vow of <s>bala</s> (power);

children.text: sarvaduṣṭān vinirjitya saṃbodhau kṛtaniścayaḥ // 60 //
children.translated_text: having conquered all the wicked, one becomes resolute in <s>saṃbodhi</s> (perfect awakening). (60)

children.text: samyagbalasamutsāhaiḥ sarvatīrthyān vinirjayet /
children.translated_text: With the vigor of right <s>bala</s> (power), one conquers all heretics;

children.text: tataḥ sādhumatīprāpto mahābrahmā bhavet kṛtī // 61 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Sādhumatī</s> (the Good Wisdom stage), one becomes the accomplished Great <s>Brahmā</s>. (61)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān buddhayānopadarśanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through displaying the <s>Buddhayāna</s> (Buddha Vehicle),

children.text: sattvāśayaparijñāne pratiṣṭhāpya prabodhayan // 62 //
children.translated_text: establishing them in the thorough knowledge of the dispositions of beings, awakening them, (62)

children.text: svayaṃ bale pratiṣṭhitvā paraṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: having oneself become established in <s>bala</s> (power), one should also direct others [to it];

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya balapāraṃgato bhavet // 63 //
children.translated_text: having established all in <s>bodhi</s>, one goes to the far shore of <s>bala</s> (power). (63)

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākaiśca jñānavratamupāśrayet /
children.translated_text: By the fruits of this merit, one should take up the vow of <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge);

children.text: caturmārān vinirjitya bodhisattvo guṇākaraḥ // 64 //
children.translated_text: having conquered the four <s>Māras</s>, the <s>bodhisattva</s> becomes a mine of virtues. (64)

children.text: samyag jñānaṃ samāsādya saddharmakuśalī bhavet /
children.translated_text: Having rightly attained <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge), one becomes skilled in the true <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: dharmameghāṃ tataḥ prāpto maheśvaro bhavet kṛtī // 65 //
children.translated_text: then, having reached <s>Dharmameghā</s> (the Cloud of Dharma stage), one becomes the accomplished <s>Maheśvara</s> (Great Lord). (65)

children.text: tatrasthaḥ pālayan sattvān sarvākārānubodhanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Abiding there, protecting beings through awakening them to all aspects of [truth],

children.text: sarvākāravare jñāne pratiṣṭhāpya prabodhayan // 66 //
children.translated_text: Establishing them in the supreme knowledge of all aspects, awakening them. // 66 //

children.text: svayaṃ jñāne pratiṣṭhitvā parāṃścāpi niyojayet /
children.translated_text: Having himself become established in knowledge, he should also engage others;

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya jñānapāraṃgato bhavet // 67 //
children.translated_text: Establishing all in <s>bodhi</s> (awakening), he would become one who has gone to the far shore of knowledge. // 67 //

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvaiśca daśabhūmīśvaro jinaḥ /
children.translated_text: Through the power of this merit, the <s>Jina</s>, lord of the ten stages,

children.text: sarvākāraguṇādhāraḥ sarvajño dharmarāḍ bhavet // 68 //
children.translated_text: The foundation of all excellent qualities, would become the omniscient king of <s>Dharma</s>. // 68 //

children.text: iti matvā bhavadbhiśca saṃbodhipadalabdhaye /
children.translated_text: Knowing this, you too, for the attainment of the state of <s>saṃbodhi</s> (perfect awakening),

children.text: daśapāramitāpūryai caritavyaṃ samāhitaiḥ // 69 //
children.translated_text: Should practice with concentrated minds, fulfilling the ten <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections). // 69 //

children.text: tathā bodhiṃ śivāṃ prāpya caturmārān vijitya ca /
children.translated_text: Having thus attained the auspicious <s>bodhi</s> and conquered the four <s>Māras</s>,

children.text: sarvān bodhau pratiṣṭhāpya nirvṛtiṃ samavāpsyatha // 70 //
children.translated_text: Establishing all in <s>bodhi</s>, you shall attain <s>nirvṛti</s> (nirvāṇa). // 70 //

children.text: etatcchrutvā parijñāya caradhvaṃ bodhisādhane /
children.translated_text: Having heard and understood this, practice the means of <s>bodhi</s>!

children.text: nirvighnaṃ bodhimāsādya labhadhvaṃ saugatāṃ gatim // 71 //
children.translated_text: Attaining <s>bodhi</s> without obstacles, obtain the destination of the <s>Sugata</s>! // 71 //

body.text:
11 parīndanāparivartaḥ /
upakramaḥ /
body.translated_text:
11. Chapter on the Entrustment (<s>parīndanāparivarta</s>).
Introduction.

body.text: etāstāḥ khalu punarbho jinaputrā daśa bodhisattvabhūmayaḥ samāsato nirdiṣṭāḥ sarvākāravaropetasarvajñajñānānugatā draṣṭavyāḥ / tasyāṃ velāyāmayaṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasro lokadhātuḥ ṣaḍvikāraṃ prākampat / vividhāni ca puṣpāṇi viyato nyapatan / divyamānuṣyakāni ca tūryāṇi saṃpravāditānyabhūvan / anumodanāśabdena ca yāvadakaniṣṭhabhuvanaṃ vijñaptamabhūt //
body.translated_text: These then, O sons of the <s>Jinas</s>, are the ten <s>Bodhisattva</s> stages, taught in summary, to be seen as endowed with all excellent aspects and following omniscient knowledge. At that moment, this three-thousandfold great-thousandfold world-system trembled in six ways. Various flowers fell from the sky. Divine and human musical instruments were sounded. And an exclamation of approval resounded up to the <s>Akaniṣṭha</s> abode.

body.text: atha tasmin samaye bhagavāṃstān vimukticandrapramukhān sarvān bodhisattvānāmantrya evamādiśat - imāmahaṃ mārṣā asaṃkhyeyakalpakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrasamudānītāmanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhiṃ yuṣmākaṃ haste parindāmi anuparindāmi paramayā parindanayā / tadyūyaṃ sarve svayaṃ caivamimaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayata, parebhyaśca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayata / saṃkṣepānmārṣā yadi tathāgataḥ kalpasthitikenāyuḥpramāṇena rātriṃdivamadhitiṣṭhamāno 'sya dharmaparyāyasya varṇaṃ bhāṣate, naivāsya dharmaparyāyasya varṇaparyanto bhavet, na ca tathāgatapratibhānakṣayo bhavet / yathā tathāgataśīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktijñānadarśanamapramāṇamaparyantam, evameva mārṣā ya imaṃ dharmaparyāyamudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati, parṣanmadhye ca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayiṣyati - anena cittena kathamamī sattvā evamudāradharmasya lābhinaḥ syuriti śraddhayā satkṛtya śrāvayiṣyanti śroṣyanti ca yoniśo manasi bhāvayiṣyanti ca / pustakalikhitaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyati satkariṣyati gurukariṣyati mānayiṣyati pūjayiṣyati / amātsaryacittatayā asya dharmaparyāyasya varṇaṃ bhāṣitvā likhanāya vācanāya svādhyayanāya pūjanāya darśanāya dāsyati, teṣāmapi nāsti puṇyaparyantaḥ //
body.translated_text: Then at that time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed all those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> led by <s>Vimukticandra</s> and proclaimed thus: 'I entrust, O Venerable Ones, this <s>anuttara-samyak-saṃbodhi</s> (supreme perfect awakening), brought forth over incalculable <s>koṭi-nayuta</s>-hundreds of thousands of <s>kalpas</s>, into your hands—I entrust it with the supreme entrustment. You should all yourselves preserve this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse and proclaim it in detail to others. In brief, O Venerable Ones, even if the <s>Tathāgata</s>, with a lifespan lasting a <s>kalpa</s>, were to speak the merits of this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse day and night, the end of the merits of this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse would not be reached, nor would the eloquence of the <s>Tathāgata</s> be exhausted. Just as the morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge-and-vision of the <s>Tathāgata</s> are immeasurable and boundless, even so, O Venerable Ones, whoever will take up this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, preserve it, recite it, copy it, have it copied, master it, propagate it, and proclaim it in detail in the midst of an assembly—with the thought: "How might these beings become recipients of such an exalted <s>Dharma</s>?"—will with faith, respect, cause others to hear it and will hear it themselves and will reflect upon it thoroughly. Having had it written in a book, one will keep it at home, honor it, revere it, esteem it, and worship it. Having spoken the merits of this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse with a mind free from jealousy, one will give it for copying, reciting, studying, worshipping, and viewing—for them too, there is no end to the merit.'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavānasyaiva dharmaparyāyasya bhūyasyā mātrayā anuparindanārthaṃ tasyāṃ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata -
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, to even further entrust this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, at that moment spoke these verses:

children.text: sattvā dṛṣṭā ye mayā buddhadṛṣṭyā te 'rhantaḥ syuḥ śāriputreṇa tulyāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those beings whom I have seen with the <s>Buddha</s>-eye—were they all <s>Arhats</s> equal to <s>Śāriputra</s>,

children.text: tāṃ cetkaścitpūjayetkalpakoṭyā tulyān gaṅgāvālukābhiryathaiva // 1 //
children.translated_text: And were someone to worship them for <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s>, as many as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> — // 1 //

children.text: pratyekabuddhāya tu yaśca pūjāṃ kuryādahorātramapi prahṛṣṭaḥ /
children.translated_text: And were one to perform worship to <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>, day and night, with a joyful heart,

children.text: mālyaprakāraiśca tathāmbaraiśca tasmādayaṃ puṇyakṛto viśiṣṭaḥ // 2 //
children.translated_text: With various garlands of flowers and garments—still, this merit-maker surpasses that. // 2 //

body.text: sarve 'pi pratyekajinā yadi syustān pūjayet kaścidihāpramattaḥ /
body.translated_text: Even if all <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s> [in the world] were present, and someone were to worship them here diligently,

body.text: puṣpaiśca gandhaiśca vilepanaiśca kalpānanekān śayanānnapānaiḥ // 3 //
body.translated_text: With flowers, incense, and unguents, for many <s>kalpas</s>, with beds, food, and drink— // 3 //

children.text: ekasya yaścaiva tathāgatasya kuryāt praṇāmamapi caikavāram /
children.translated_text: Whoever makes even a single prostration to a single <s>Tathāgata</s>,

children.text: prasannacitto 'tha vadennamo 'rhan tasmādidaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ ca puṇyam // 4 //
children.translated_text: With a serene mind, saying '<s>Namo</s> <s>Arhat</s>'—this merit is far superior. // 4 //

children.text: buddhā bhaveyuryadi sarvasattvāstān pūjayet yaśca yathaiva pūrvam /
children.translated_text: Were all beings to become <s>Buddhas</s>, and someone were to worship them as before,

children.text: divyaiśca puṣpairatha mānuṣaiśca kalpānanekān bahubhiḥ prakāraiḥ // 5 //
children.translated_text: With divine and human flowers, for many <s>kalpas</s>, in manifold ways— // 5 //

children.text: yaścaiva saddharmavilopakāle tyaktvā svakāyaṃ ca tathātmajīvam /
children.translated_text: Whoever, at the time of the disappearance of the true <s>Dharma</s>, giving up one's own body and life,

children.text: dadyādahorātramidaṃ hi sūtraṃ viśiṣyate puṇyamidaṃ hi tasmāt // 6 //
children.translated_text: Gives this <s>sūtra</s> day and night—this merit is indeed superior to that. // 6 //

children.text: yasyepsitaṃ pūjayituṃ jinendrān pratyekabuddhānapi śrāvakāṃśca /
children.translated_text: Whoever desires to worship the lords of the <s>Jinas</s>, the <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>, and the <s>Śrāvakas</s>,

children.text: dṛḍhaṃ samutpādya sa bodhicittam idaṃ sadā sūtravaraṃ dadātu // 7 //
children.translated_text: Having firmly generated the <s>bodhicitta</s> (mind of awakening), should always give this excellent <s>sūtra</s>. // 7 //

children.text: rājā hyayaṃ sarvasubhāṣitānāṃ so 'bhudgataḥ sarvatathāgatānāma /
children.translated_text: For this is the king of all well-spoken words; it has arisen from all <s>Tathāgatas</s>;

children.text: gṛhe sthitastasya tathāgataḥ sa tiṣṭhedidaṃ yatra hi sūtraratnam // 8 //
children.translated_text: In the house where this jewel of a <s>sūtra</s> exists, there the <s>Tathāgata</s> himself abides. // 8 //

children.text: prabhāṃ sa prāpnoti śubhāmanantām ekaṃ padaṃ vādi śatīhayaśca /
children.translated_text: One obtains infinite auspicious radiance, and whoever teaches even a single word or a hundred [words],

children.text: na vyañjanād grasyati nāpi cārthād dadāti yaḥ sūtramidaṃ parebhyaḥ // 9 //
children.translated_text: Neither omitting a syllable nor the meaning—whoever gives this <s>sūtra</s> to others— // 9 //

children.text: anuttarāsau naranāyakānāṃ sattvo na kaścit sadṛśo 'sya vidyate /
children.translated_text: That being is unsurpassed among the leaders of men; no being is found equal to him;

children.text: bhavetsamudreṇa samaśca so 'kṣayaḥ śrutvā hi yo dharmamimaṃ prapadyate // 10 //
children.translated_text: He would be equal to the ocean and inexhaustible—whoever, having heard this <s>Dharma</s>, takes refuge in it. // 10 //

body.text: According the edition by Ryūkḥ Kondḥ (reproduced Kyoto 1983) the end of the sūtra is:
body.translated_text: According to the edition by Ryūkō Kondō (reproduced Kyoto 1983), the end of the <s>sūtra</s> is:

body.text: idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te vimukticandrapūrvaṃgamā bodhisattvagaṇā vaśavartidevarājapramukhāḥ sarvadevādhipatīśvarāś ca mahānandapūrvaṃgamā sarvamahāśrāvakagaṇāḥ sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca lokaḥ sā sarvāvatī parṣad bhagavato vajragarbhasya bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti //
body.translated_text: Thus spoke the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Delighted, the assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> led by <s>Vimukticandra</s>, all the great lords of the gods headed by the <s>Vaśavartin</s> god-king, all the great assemblies of <s>Śrāvakas</s> headed by <s>Mahānanda</s>, and the world with its <s>devas</s>, humans, <s>asuras</s>, and <s>gandharvas</s>—that entire assembly rejoiced at the words spoken by the <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Vajragarbha</s>.

body.text: iti parindanāparivarto nāmaikādaśamaḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus ends the eleventh chapter called the Chapter on Entrustment (<s>Parīndanāparivarta</s>).

body.text: iti śrībodhisattvacaryāprasthāno daśabhūmīśvaro nāma mahāyānasūtraratnarājaḥ samāptaḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus is completed the King of <s>Mahāyāna Sūtra</s>-Jewels called the <s>Daśabhūmīśvara</s> (Lord of the Ten Stages), belonging to the Course of the Noble <s>Bodhisattva</s> Conduct.

children.text: ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetun teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat /
children.translated_text: Those <s>dharmas</s> which arise from causes—their cause the <s>Tathāgata</s> has declared,

children.text: teṣāṃ ca yo nirodho evaṃ vādī mahāśramaṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: And also their cessation—thus teaches the Great <s>Śramaṇa</s>.

body.text: // śubham //
body.translated_text: // Auspiciousness //
